Quantinuum has unveiled the Nexus Roadmap, outlining a new developer platform tailored for the emerging fault‑tolerant quantum computing era. The initiative aims to provide tools and infrastructure that enable developers to build and deploy applications on stable, large‑scale quantum systems. This marks Quantinuum’s first dedicated platform designed specifically to support fault‑tolerant quantum technology.
